feeds.title: GaPundit
feeds.description: GaPundit.com, a leading source for Georgia politics from a right-of-centre perspective, draws on over two decades of experience in Republican politics. Todd Rehm, Editor and President of Sand Mountain Communications, LLC, compiles the morning news, reaching 65,000 subscribers via email.

feeds.title: Athens Politics Nerd
feeds.description: Athens Politics Nerd is an independent media organization using short YouTube videos to keep you up to date with local news and politics in the Athens, Georgia area. APN also presents info and opinion on progressive policy options for the state and federal governments as well.

feeds.title: The Georgia Recorder Government & Politics
feeds.description: The Georgia Recorder is an independent, nonprofit news organization that is focused on connecting public policies to stories of the people and communities affected by them. Covers articles on Government and political news.

feeds.title: WSAV News 3 Politics
feeds.description: WSAV News 3 is the NBC affiliate serving the Coastal Empire and the Lowcountry. Covers the Latest News and Updates in Politics.

feeds.title: Cherokee Tribune & Ledger News
feeds.description: Cherokee Tribune & Ledger covers local news and community events and sports in Cherokee County, GA. Our mission is to serve and represent the people of Cherokee County by providing stories that are honest, fair, accurate and have editorial integrity.

feeds.title: All On Georgia Politics
feeds.description: All On Georgia is a hyper-local news organization bringing you community and Georgia-based news, politics, and commentary from every corner of the state.

feeds.title: Georgia Political Review
feeds.description: Georgia Political Review seeks to publish quality original content from University of Georgia undergraduates in the fields of political science, international affairs, history, and economics.

feeds.title: GeorgiaPol
feeds.description: GeorgiaPol is multi-partisan news and opinion source that strives to be the media hub for news, analysis, opinion, and discussion of politics and policy in the state of Georgia.

feeds.title: FiveThirtyEight Georgia Politics
feeds.description: Nate Silver's FiveThirtyEight uses statistical analysis, hard numbers to tell compelling stories about elections, politics, sports, science, economics, and lifestyle. This blog section covers Georgia Political updates.

feeds.title: WABE News Politics
feeds.description: WABE is Atlanta's NPR station, keeping you informed with essential news and vital context. Browse political news from Georgia and across the globe.
